description: Central Bank of Sri Lanka - Liquidation Order (Winding up of Central Investments and Finance Ltd.)
categorisation: This gazette content contains a court order for the winding up of a finance company under the supervision of the court, issued pursuant to the Companies Act and the Finance Business Act. It is a legal notice concerning the judicial process of liquidating a company, which falls under legal/regulatory matters (new laws, acts, regulations, legal notices, and statutory declarations).
